name: Ankhesenamun
subtitle: Sunrise Redeemer
description: Attempts to save allies from dying. Cleanses negative effects from the team.
lore: A largely forgotten queen, Ankhesenamun is known for her marriage to multiple pharaohs—including Tutankhamen—but little else, as she was deliberately stricken from most of Aaru’s histories along with her third husband, Tutankhamen’s successor. She has now taken advantage of the cultural, mystical, and spiritual repercussions of that partial anonymity, studying magical secrets that would previously have been unavailable to her.
divinity_generator: Gain [75] Divinity when an ally uses an Ultimate ability.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +5%, Armor Multiplier +2.5%, Weapon Multiplier +2.5%
